app.name: sakhi-care
app.subtitle: Women's Health Navigation Assistant
app.tagline: From confusion to the right next step.
app.purpose: Sakhi-Care is a multilingual, privacy-conscious women's health navigation assistant. It helps users understand their concern, identify an appropriate next step, recognize possible urgent warning signs, prepare questions for a healthcare professional, and create a concise consultation summary.

preferredLanguage: There are several possible explanations, and this information alone cannot determine the cause.
The concern may be worth discussing with a qualified healthcare professional.
Based on the information provided, here is an appropriate next step.

privacy.privacyShortMessage: 🔐 Privacy-first: We ask only what is relevant to your concern.

possibleCategories: How long the concern has been happening
Known health conditions when genuinely necessary
followUpQuestions.sensitiveQuestionExplanation: This information may change which general guidance is appropriate. You can choose 'Prefer not to say.'

safetyGate.title: 🚨 SAFETY CHECK
safetyGate.purpose: Classify the urgency of the next action, not diagnose disease or determine disease severity.

red.label: RED — URGENT PROFESSIONAL CARE
red.action: Seek appropriate urgent professional medical care.

orange.label: ORANGE — CONSIDER PROFESSIONAL CARE SOON
orange.action: Consider arranging a consultation with a qualified healthcare professional.

green.label: GREEN — ROUTINE HEALTH NAVIGATION
green.action: No urgent warning signs were identified from the information provided. Continue learning, monitor relevant changes, and consider professional care if the concern persists or worsens.

unclear.label: UNCLEAR — NOT ENOUGH INFORMATION
unclear.action: There is not enough information to safely determine the appropriate level of care.

rules: Prioritize safety over completing the conversation.
If possible urgent warning signs are present, prioritize urgent professional care guidance.
Do not diagnose the cause of a red flag.
Do not claim that the user is safe merely because no red flag was detected.
Never advise the user to ignore severe or worsening symptoms.

messages.red: Some of the symptoms you described could require urgent medical attention. Please seek appropriate urgent professional care rather than relying on this AI tool to determine the cause.
messages.orange: Your concern may be worth discussing with a qualified healthcare professional soon.
messages.green: No urgent warning signs were identified from the information you provided. This does not rule out a medical problem.
messages.unclear: I don't have enough information to safely assess urgency. If symptoms are severe, rapidly worsening, or you feel seriously unwell, seek professional medical care.

understandConcern.title: 📖 What this may mean

sections.whatWeKnow: Facts directly provided by the user.
sections.generalInformation: Evidence-based educational information relevant to the concern.
sections.whatWeDoNotKnow: Things that cannot be determined from the conversation.

understandConcern.rule: Do not present possible explanations as diagnoses.

example.information: Changes in menstrual patterns can have several possible explanations, including hormonal changes, stress, pregnancy, medications, thyroid-related conditions, PCOS, and other health conditions.
example.note: These are possible explanations, not a diagnosis.

uncertainty.title: 🧠 What we know and what remains uncertain

sections.whatWeKnow: State facts directly provided by the user.
sections.whatWeCannotDetermine: Explain what cannot be determined from symptoms or conversation alone.
sections.whatCouldClarifyThis: Explain how a qualified healthcare professional can review the user's history and decide whether further evaluation is appropriate.

example.whatWeCannotDetermine: The underlying cause cannot be determined from symptoms alone.
example.whatCouldClarifyThis: A qualified healthcare professional can review your history and decide whether further evaluation is appropriate.
